question: Which prestigious award did hockey player Harmanpreet Singh receive from President Droupadi Murmu at a specially organised function at Rashtrapati Bhavan in January 2025?

options.text: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award

solution:
The correct answer is __**Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian men's hockey team captain **Harmanpreet Singh** was honored with the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**, India's highest sporting honor, by President **Droupadi Murmu**.
 
• The award ceremony took place in **January 2025** during a specially organized function at the **Rashtrapati Bhavan** in **New Delhi**.
 
• **Harmanpreet Singh** was recognized for his extraordinary leadership and stellar performance at the **Paris 2024 Olympics**, where he led the Indian team to a second consecutive **bronze medal**.
 
• During the **Paris 2024 Olympics**, he emerged as the **top scorer** of the tournament, netting **10 goals**, showcasing his mastery as one of the world's best **drag-flickers**.
 
• This recognition places him among the elite group of Indian hockey players, such as **Dhanraj Pillay**, **Sardar Singh**, and **Manpreet Singh**, who have received this prestigious accolade in the past.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**:
 
 
• It is the **highest sporting honor** of the Republic of India, awarded annually by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• The award was formerly known as the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** but was renamed in **August 2021** in honor of the legendary hockey wizard **Major Dhyan Chand**.
 
• The award includes a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize of **₹25 lakh**.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Award**:
 
 
• Established in **1961**, it is awarded for **outstanding performance** in sports and games over a period of the previous **four years**.
 
• It carries a cash prize of **₹15 lakh** and a bronze statue of **Arjuna**.
 
 
 
• **Dronacharya Award**:
 
 
• Introduced in **1985**, this award is presented to **coaches** who have enabled sportspersons to achieve excellence in international events.
 
• The **Regular Category** carries a prize of **₹10 lakh**, while the **Lifetime Category** carries **₹15 lakh**.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Awards**:
 
 
• These awards are typically conferred by the **President of India** at the **Rashtrapati Bhavan** to recognize and reward excellence in sports.
 
• The selection committee is usually headed by a retired **Supreme Court** or **High Court Judge** and includes eminent sportspersons and sports administrators.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Harmanpreet Singh**, often affectionately called **"Sarpanch Sahib"** by fans, has been a pillar of the Indian defense and the primary source of goals through **penalty corners**.
 
• He played a vital role in ending India's **41-year** Olympic medal drought in hockey at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** and followed it up with another medal in **Paris 2024**.
 
• The **Paris 2024** campaign was significant as it marked the first time since **1972** that India won back-to-back Olympic medals in men's hockey.
 
• The **Khel Ratna** is awarded for "most outstanding performance by a sportsperson" over the period of **four years** preceding the year of the award.
